other.text: - [^13] "William James" (author name span, frontmatter source line): pass. It is the first naming of the author in the note, so the later "my"/"I" statements resolve. No cut of the "I" in "Pragmatism says no, and I fully agree with her" would carry the agreement without leaving the "I" dangling.

other.text: - [^23] "the Absolute of transcendental idealism" (section "Pragmatism as Mediator Between Empiricism and Religion"): pass. It names the same Absolute that James called "majestic" and "sterile" there and returns to here.
